thread:
vivian: Quick sync — AcmeHealth put in a high-priority ask for more granular observability across Hosted/Dedicated. They called it 'Gaugeboard' (dashboards + tracing + cost by route). Can we triage scope?

sam: Saw the note. My initial thought: scope to 3 core surfaces to start — latency (p50/p95/p99), cost-per-request (token-based), and error-rate by model/route. Keep it lightweight for MVP.

neil: Tracing hooks: we should emit a span for routing decision + cache hit/miss + model-variant. That gives us the join keys for all three surfaces. Low-risk change but runtime touch.

anya: UX: agree on small-card layout. Need tenant selector and time-range quick presets. Also CSV export for enterprise customers (Acme asked explicitly).

marta: Confirming Acme wants weekly per-customer cost exports + the ability to slice by model family and route. They also asked for alerting on sudden cost spikes.

obs-bot: Note: current metrics pipeline lacks consistent "model_variant" and "route" tags. Any dashboard depends on us emitting those tags end-to-end.

vivian: Proposal for Launch Criteria (preliminary):
- Dashboards (Hosted + Dedicated) with widgets: p99 latency, avg cost/request, error % by route/model
- Tracing hooks with route + cache tags emitted in spans
- Per-customer weekly CSV export for cost breakdown
- Canary rollout plan (5% traffic) + perf benchmark showing <= 5% overhead
- Alerts: cost spike rule + p99 latency breach rule
- Eval/regression: no QoL regression on sample prompt set

sam: Notes on engineering constraints: runtime change (span tagging) likely adds ~0.5-1ms per request on GPU paths — need bench. Also metric cardinality risk if we tag too many dimensions (model_checkpoint + prompt_template + route). Recommend we only tag: route, model_family, model_variant, cache_hit.

neil: For canary and rollback: plan to run tracing hooks behind a feature flag. Canary config: 5% of dedicated pools for 48h, monitor p99, error rate, and token-cost delta. Rollback criteria: p99 increases > 20% or error rate increase > 2x baseline. I'll draft runbook.

anya: UX deliverables: wireframe for Gaugeboard cards + tenant filter + export modal. Will attach mocks by EOW. Small ask: default time windows should be 1h/6h/24h/7d.

marta: Customer ops: Acme will need a private S3 drop for weekly CSVs (HIPAA-ish). We should include KMS tagging and a retention policy.

vivian: Actionable acceptance checklist (mutable):
- [ ] Metrics emitted: route, model_family, model_variant, cache_hit
- [ ] Dashboard cards implemented for hosted + dedicated
- [ ] Tracing spans present and showing route/cache tags in trace UI
- [ ] Weekly per-customer cost CSV generation + secure delivery option
- [ ] Canary runbook + rollback steps documented
- [ ] UX mockups reviewed by customer success
- [ ] Performance bench: overhead <= 5% at tail

sam: Rough timing estimate: metrics tagging + small runtime change = 1 sprint; tracing hooks + benching = 1 sprint; dashboards + CSV export = 1 sprint. Could parallelize tagging + UX. Dependencies: metrics schema change and backend ingestion updates.

neil: I will own canary config and runbook. Will draft steps + pager triggers. Expect initial doc by Tue (1766002000).

anya: Will attach mocks by Wed (1766003000).

marta: I'll coordinate with Acme for S3 credentials and retention requirements; aim to confirm by Fri.

vivian: Risks & tradeoffs called out:
- Cardinality blowup if we add too many tags -> cost in metrics storage. Mitigation: restrict to model_family + model_variant (no prompt_template).
- Runtime perf impact -> canary + bench.
- CSV export complexity for on-prem/dedicated customers -> provide S3 + secure-transfer extension.

sam: Implementation note: add a small opt-in flag to runtime config: "emit_route_span_tags: true". Example snippet for runtime instrumentation:
```
span.set_attribute("route", route_name)
span.set_attribute("cache_hit", cache_hit ? "1" : "0")
span.set_attribute("model_variant", model.variant)
```
This will make tracing and metrics downstream joins easier.

neil: +1. Also ensure trace sampling includes the canary traffic (set sampling override for 5% cohort).

vivian: OK — consensus seems to be: proceed with scoped MVP (cards + core tags + CSV export), canary at 5%, UX mocks this week, runbook next week. I'll schedule a follow-up sync Thu to lock acceptance and commit tickets. :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup: Acme will be relieved to see a concrete plan.

sam: I'll open the runtime PR and link benches.

neil: I'll draft the canary runbook and add rollback playbook.

anya: UX uploaded Wed, will ping here.

obs-bot: Reminder: update metrics schema doc after tagging is finalized.

vivian: Thanks team — closing thread for now, will post updates in this channel.
